name: keeping the baseline
from: Settled meaning whatever the tree currently says: no one able to state what the firm agreed to, what changed since, or by whose decision — the record and the history of the record one undifferentiated pile.
to: The equality held: what the firm treats as settled is exactly what is in a baseline, every item in it arrived by a change-control-board decision this office recorded, each work product names the baseline it was checked against, and a change that tried to arrive around the board was refused with the refusal on the record.
cost: Recording at every approved change and refusing at every unapproved one — clerical, constant, and valuable precisely in proportion to how boring it stays.
otherwise: An item that reached the baseline around the board is indistinguishable afterward from one that came through it, so one leak retroactively poisons the whole record's warrant — not just the leaked item.
